info.name: Public API to import Clozd deal and participant data

params.name: program_id
params.description: Clozd program ID (min:36 chars, max:36 chars)

items.docs:
Public API to import 1 or many deals and 0 or many participants associated with the deal. Make sure the header is set with a key value pair being Key: x-api-token Value: (api token provided from the settings section within the Clozd application). The body of the post request will follow the schema below. If an attribute is required or a wrong value type is provided the POST request will be rolled back and rejected.
